text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

translations.asad: Alif. Lam. Ra. THESE ARE MESSAGES of revelation -of a discourse clear in itself and clearly showing the truth.
translations.sahih: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.

text.arabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ

translations.asad: And it will come to pass that those who are [now] bent on denying this truth will wish that they had surrendered themselves to God [in their life time].
translations.sahih: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.

text.arabic: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.asad: Leave them alone; let them eat and enjoy themselves the while the hope [of vain delights] be guiles them: for in time they will come to know [the truth].
translations.sahih: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.

text.arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ

translations.asad: And never have We destroyed any community [for its wrongdoing] unless a divine writ had (previously] been made known to it;
translations.sahih: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.

text.arabic: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

translations.asad: [but remember that] no community can ever forestall [the end of] its term - and neither can they delay [it].
translations.sahih: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.

text.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ

translations.asad: And yet, they [who deny the truth] say: "O thou unto whom this reminder has [allegedly] been bestowed from on high: verily, thou art mad!
translations.sahih: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.

text.arabic: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

translations.asad: Why dost thou not bring before us angels, if thou art a man of truth?
translations.sahih: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"

text.arabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ

translations.asad: [Yet] We never send down angels otherwise than in accordance with the [demands of] truth; and [were the angels to appear now,] lo! they [who reject this divine writ] would have no further respite!
translations.sahih: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.

text.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ

translations.asad: Behold, it is We Ourselves who have bestowed from on high, step by step, this reminder? and, behold, it is We who shall truly guard it [from all corruption].
translations.sahih: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.asad: AND, INDEED, [O Prophet,] even before thy time did We send [Our apostles] unto communities of old -
translations.sahih: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.

text.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

translations.asad: and never yet came an apostle to them without their deriding him.
translations.sahih: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.

text.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

translations.asad: Even so do We [now] cause this [scorn of Our message] to pervade the hearts of those who are lost in sin,
translations.sahih: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.

text.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.asad: who do not believe in it, although the way which those [evildoers] of olden times had to go has long been within their ken.
translations.sahih: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.

text.arabic: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ

translations.asad: Yet even had We opened to them a gateway to heaven and they had ascended, on and on, up to it,
translations.sahih: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,

text.arabic: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ

translations.asad: they would surely have said, "It is only our eyes that are spellbound! Nay, we have been bewitched!,
translations.sahih: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ

translations.asad: AND, INDEED, We have set up in the heavens great constellations, and endowed them with beauty for all to behold;
translations.sahih: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.

text.arabic: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍ

translations.asad: and We have made them secure against every satanic force accursed -
translations.sahih: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]

text.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

translations.asad: so that anyone who seeks to learn [the unknowable] by stealth is pursued by a flame clear to see.
translations.sahih: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.

text.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مَّوْزُونٍۢ

translations.asad: And the earth -We have spread it out wide, and placed on it mountains firm, and caused [life] of every kind to grow on it in a balanced manner,
translations.sahih: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.

text.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ

translations.asad: and provided thereon means of livelihood for you [O men] as well as for all [living beings] whose sustenance does not depend on you.
translations.sahih: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.

text.arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ

translations.asad: For, no single thing exists that does not have its source with Us; and nought do We bestow from on high unless it be in accordance with a measure well-defined.
translations.sahih: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.

text.arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ

translations.asad: And We let loose the winds to fertilize [plants] and We send down water from the skies and let you drink thereof: and it is not you who dispose of its source-
translations.sahih: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.

text.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ

translations.asad: for, behold, it is We-We alone -who grant life and deal death, and it is We alone who shall remain after all else will have passed away!
translations.sahih: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ

translations.asad: And well do We know [the hearts and deeds of all human beings - both] those who lived before you and those who will come after you;
translations.sahih: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].

text.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

translations.asad: and, behold, it is thy Sustainer who will gather them all together [on Judgment Day]: verily, He is wise, all-knowing!
translations.sahih: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ

translations.asad: AND, INDEED, We have created man out of sounding clay, out of dark-slime transmuted
translations.sahih: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.

text.arabic: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ

translations.asad: whereas the invisible beings We had created, [long] before that, out of the fire of scorching winds.
translations.sahih: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.

text.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ

translations.asad: And lo! Thy Sustainer said unto the angels: "Behold, I am about to create mortal man out of sounding clay, out of dark slime transmuted;
translations.sahih: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.

text.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ

translations.asad: and when I have formed him fully and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down before him in prostration!
translations.sahih: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

text.arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

translations.asad: Thereupon the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together,
translations.sahih: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

text.arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

translations.asad: save Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated themselves.
translations.sahih: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.

text.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

translations.asad: Said He: "O Iblis! What is thy reason for not being among those who have prostrated themselves?"
translations.sahih: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"

text.arabic: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ

translations.asad: [Iblis] replied: "It is not for me to prostrate myself before mortal man whom Thou hast created out of sounding clay, out of dark slime transmuted!"
translations.sahih: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."

text.arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ

translations.asad: Said He: "Go forth, then, from this [angelic state]: for, behold, thou art [henceforth] accursed,
translations.sahih: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.

text.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

translations.asad: and [My] rejection shall be thy due until the Day of Judgment!"
translations.sahih: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."

text.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

translations.asad: Said [Iblis]: "Then, O my Sustainer, grant me a respite till the Day when all shall be raised from the dead!"
translations.sahih: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

text.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ

translations.asad: Answered He: "Verily, so be it: thou shalt be among those who are granted respite
translations.sahih: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

text.arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ

translations.asad: till the Day the time whereof is known [to Me alone]."
translations.sahih: Until the Day of the time well-known."

text.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.asad: [Whereupon Iblis] said: "O my Sustainer! Since Thou hast thwarted me, I shall indeed make [all that is evil] on earth seem goodly to them, and shall most certainly beguile them-into grievous error -
translations.sahih: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all

text.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

translations.asad: [all] save such of them as are truly Thy servants!"
translations.sahih: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

text.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ

translations.asad: Said He: "This is, with Me. a straight way:
translations.sahih: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.

text.arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ

translations.asad: verily, thou shalt have no power over My creatures- unless it be such as are [already] lost in grievous error and follow thee [of their own will]:
translations.sahih: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

text.arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.asad: and for all such, behold, hell is the promised goal.
translations.sahih: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.

text.arabic: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ

translations.asad: with seven gates leading into it, each gate receiving its allotted share of sinners. -
translations.sahih: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated."

text.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ

translations.asad: VERILY, those who are conscious of God [shall find themselves in the hereafter] amidst gardens and springs,
translations.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs.

text.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ

translations.asad: [having been received with the greeting,] "Enter here in peace, secure!"
translations.sahih: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."

text.arabic: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

translations.asad: And [by then] We shall have removed whatever unworthy thoughts or feelings may have been [lingering] in their breasts, [and they shall rest] as brethren, facing one another [in love] upon thrones of happiness.
translations.sahih: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.

text.arabic: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ

translations.asad: No weariness shall ever touch them in this [state of bliss], and never shall they have to forgo it.
translations.sahih: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.

text.arabic: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

translations.asad: Tell My servants that I - I alone - am truly forgiving, a true dispenser of grace;
translations.sahih: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.

text.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ

translations.asad: and [also,] that the suffering which I shall impose [on sinners] will indeed be a suffering most grievous.
translations.sahih: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.

text.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

translations.asad: AND TELL THEM [once again] about Abraham's guests -
translations.sahih: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,

text.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ

translations.asad: [how,] when they presented themselves before him and bade him peace, he answered: "Behold, we are afraid of you!"
translations.sahih: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you."

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ

translations.asad: Said they: "Fear not! Behold, we bring thee the glad tiding of [the birth of] a son who will be endowed with deep knowledge."
translations.sahih: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."

text.arabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ

translations.asad: Said he: "Do you give me this glad tiding despite the fact that old age has overtaken me? Of what [strange thing], then, are you giving me a tiding!"
translations.sahih: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ

translations.asad: They answered: "We have given thee the glad tiding of something that is bound to come true. - so be not of those who abandon hope!"
translations.sahih: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."

text.arabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ

translations.asad: [Abraham] exclaimed: "And who-other than those who have utterly lost their way-could ever abandon the hope of his Sustainer's grace?"
translations.sahih: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"

text.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

translations.asad: He added: "And what [else] may you have in view, O you [heavenly] messengers?"
translations.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

text.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ

translations.asad: They answered: "We are sent to people lost in sin [who are to be destroyed],
translations.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,

text.arabic: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.asad: barring Lot's household, all of whom, behold, we shall save -
translations.sahih: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all

text.arabic: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ

translations.asad: excepting only his wife, [of whom God says,] `We have ordained [that], behold, she should be among those who stay behind!'
translations.sahih: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind.

text.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

translations.asad: AND WHEN the messengers [of God] came to the house of Lot,
translations.sahih: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,

text.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ

translations.asad: he said: "Behold, you are people unknown [here]!"
translations.sahih: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."

text.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

translations.asad: They answered: "Nay, but we have come unto thee with [the announcement of] something that they [who are given to evil] have always been wont to call in question,
translations.sahih: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,

text.arabic: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ

translations.asad: and we are bringing thee the certainty [of its fulfilment]: for, behold, we are speaking the truth indeed.
translations.sahih: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.

text.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ

translations.asad: Go, then., with thy household while it is yet night, with thyself following them in the rear; and let none of you look back, but proceed whither you are bidden."
translations.sahih: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."

text.arabic: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ

translations.asad: And [through Our messengers] We revealed unto him this decree: "The last remnant of those [sinners] shall be wiped out" in the morn."
translations.sahih: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.

text.arabic: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

translations.asad: And the people of the city came [unto Lot], rejoicing at the glad tiding.
translations.sahih: And the people of the city came rejoicing.

text.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ

translations.asad: Exclaimed [Lot]: "Behold, these are my guests: so put me not to shame,
translations.sahih: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.

text.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ

translations.asad: but be conscious of God and disgrace me not!"
translations.sahih: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me."

text.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.asad: They answered: "Have we not forbidden thee [to offer protection] to any kind of people?"
translations.sahih: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"

text.arabic: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ

translations.asad: [Lot] said: "[Take instead] these daughters of mine, if you must do [whatever you intend to do]!"
translations.sahih: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."

text.arabic: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

translations.asad: [But the angels spoke thus:] "As thou livest, [O Lot, they will not listen to thee:] behold, in their delirium [of lust] they are but blindly stumbling to and fro!"
translations.sahih: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.

text.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ

translations.asad: And thereupon the blast [of Our punishment] overtook them at the time of sunrise,
translations.sahih: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.

text.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

translations.asad: and We turned those [sinful towns} upside down, and rained down upon them stone-hard blows of chastisement pre-ordained.
translations.sahih: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.

text.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ

translations.asad: Verily, in all this there are messages indeed for those who can read the signs:
translations.sahih: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.

text.arabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ

translations.asad: for, behold, those [towns] stood by a road that still exists.
translations.sahih: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road.

text.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: Verily, herein lies a message indeed for all who believe [in God].
translations.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.

text.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ

translations.asad: AND THE DWELLERS of the wooded dales [of Madyan, too,] were inveterate evildoers,
translations.sahih: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers.

text.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

translations.asad: and so We inflicted Our retribution on them. And, behold, both these [sinful communities] lived by a highway, [to this day] plain to see
translations.sahih: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.asad: AND, [likewise,] indeed, the people of Al-Hijr gave the lie to [Our] message-bearers:
translations.sahih: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers.

text.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

translations.asad: for We did vouchsafe them Our messages, but they obstinately turned their backs upon them-
translations.sahih: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.

text.arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ

translations.asad: notwithstanding that they had been wont [to enjoy Our blessings and] to hew out dwellings from the mountains, [wherein they could live] in security
translations.sahih: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.

text.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ

translations.asad: and so the blast [of Our punishment] overtook them at early morn,
translations.sahih: But the shriek seized them at early morning.

text.arabic: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

translations.asad: and of no avail to them was all [the power] that they had acquired.
translations.sahih: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.

text.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ

translations.asad: AND [remember:] We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them without [an inner] truth; but, behold, the Hour [when this will become clear to all] is indeed yet to come. Hence, forgive [men's failings] with fair forbearance:
translations.sahih: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

text.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

translations.asad: verily, thy Sustainer is the all-knowing Creator of all things!
translations.sahih: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ

translations.asad: AND, INDEED, We have bestowed upon thee seven of the oft repeated [verses], and [have, thus, laid open before thee] this sublime Qur'an:
translations.sahih: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.

text.arabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.asad: [so] turn, not thine eyes [longingly] towards the worldly benefits which We have granted unto some of those [that deny the truth]. And neither grieve over those [who refuse to heed thee], but spread the wings of thy tenderness over the believers,
translations.sahih: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers

text.arabic: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

translations.asad: and say: "Behold, I am indeed the plain warner [promised by God]!
translations.sahih: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -

text.arabic: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ

translations.asad: [For, thou art the bearer of a divine writ] such as We have bestowed from on high upon those who [afterwards] broke it up into parts,
translations.sahih: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators

text.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ

translations.asad: [and] who [now] declare this Qur'an to be [a tissue of] falsehoods!
translations.sahih: Who have made the Qur'an into portions.

text.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.asad: But, by thy Sustainer! [On the Day of Judgment] We shall indeed call them to account, one and all,
translations.sahih: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all

text.arabic: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.asad: for whatever they have done!
translations.sahih: About what they used to do.

text.arabic: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

translations.asad: Hence, proclaim openly all that thou hast been bidden [to say], and leave alone all those who ascribe divinity to aught beside God:
translations.sahih: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.

text.arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ

translations.asad: verily, We shall suffice thee against all who [now] deride [this message - all]
translations.sahih: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers

text.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.asad: who assert that there are, side by side with God, other divine powers as well: for in time they will come to know [the truth].
translations.sahih: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ

translations.asad: And well do We know that thy bosom is constricted by the [blasphemous] things that they say:
translations.sahih: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.

text.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

translations.asad: but extol thou thy Sustainer's limitless glory and praise Him, and be of those who prostrate themselves [before Him] in adoration,
translations.sahih: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].

text.arabic: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ

translations.asad: and worship thy Sustainer till death comes to thee.
translations.sahih: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).
